main.description: A lifeline-commons coverage + resilience verdict for one region × lifeline cell, computed on read (ADR-2606272100). 入会 (iriai) = the traditional COMMONS; the lifelines (電気/水道/ガス/通信) are held as a commons right of use. A COVERAGE + RESILIENCE map, NEVER a target-list, NEVER a shut-off list — a lifeline is never withheld as leverage (G1). ASSESSMENT + R0 DESIGN ONLY — iriai never produces nor actuates; production is hikari/mizuho/kamado/noroshi under Council.

region.description: region id (a lifeline service area = the commons boundary; aggregate, no per-person location, G1)

source.description: the producer actor that sources this lifeline (iriai composes, never produces)

commonsGap.description: edge-primary commons-gap ×1000: (1−coverage)·essentiality·(0.5+0.5·vulnerability), on read — how much essential lifeline is MISSING (the §1.16 reach gap)

unservedPop.description: people without this lifeline in this region (aggregate, G1)

n1Margin.description: N-1 contingency margin ×1000; < 0 = chokepoint (the amime lens)

verdict.description: the commons gate's decision; consent gates every BUILD but a lifeline is never WITHHELD (there is no deny verdict)

route.description: downstream route for an action verdict

computedOnRead.description: edge-primary — a transient integral of disclosed facts, not stored ground state

isShutoffList.description: G1 — a coverage MAP, never a shut-off / target list; a lifeline is never withheld as leverage

neverActuates.description: G5 — iriai never energizes a grid, opens a valve, ignites gas, or activates a link; :iriai/actuate unrepresentable

sourcing.description: G8 — :synthetic at R0; real coverage data is an operator/Council step
